title: pastinaca barbata
intro: Pastinaca barbata, commonly known as wild parsnip, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including treating digestive issues, such as bloating and indigestion, due to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The therapeutic actions of wild parsnip include its antispasmodic, expectorant, and diuretic properties, which help in alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and cough, and promoting urination. The bioactive constituents of Pastinaca barbata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
